gates.summary: Live tiles follow the model's tile geometry (late selection, partial edges, stage changes); completed comparisons stay responsive while another job runs; folder jobs save together; queue estimates separate measured from unmeasured work.
gates.next_action: Repeat the recorded cases on each new package.

gates.summary: The macOS beta is Developer ID signed, notarized and stapled. Images, video, cancellation, worker recovery, the in-app update and the system-codec route passed on an M1 Pro.
gates.next_action: Keep the accepted hashes; re-run the trust checks on every new build.

gates.summary: The beta feed is live on the website. Downloads are verified by size, SHA-256 and minisign signature; truncated and substituted archives are rejected; settings, recipes and the queue are backed up before an install.
gates.next_action: Publish every future entry only after installing it from the feed on a test machine.

gates.summary: A complete five-minute 480p clip exported at 2x on ROCm (9,000 frames, audio intact); a six-frame 4K to 8K export and recovery from a forced output-size failure passed.
gates.next_action: Keep the workload limits documented; a full 4K export of several minutes has not been exercised.

gates.summary: NAFNet and SPAN can diverge on some inputs. Bounded retries and a pre-quantization guard reject unstable output instead of saving it; two of eleven reproduced scans are rejected.
gates.next_action: Document the rejection limit and keep the originals.

gates.summary: Every catalog download names its author, source and license. NomosWebPhoto and HFA2k download under the author's CC BY 4.0 terms with attribution; the two HAT face checkpoints require a verified user import; no weights are bundled.
gates.next_action: Keep the notices in sync with the catalog.

gates.summary: The Windows CPU, DirectML and NVIDIA CUDA installers of v0.1.3-beta are built on GitHub-hosted runners with the licensing-clean media runtime (MSYS2 UCRT64 plus MSVC), pass verify_codec_allowlist, the NVIDIA redistribution policy, an installed-package smoke test and the architecture check, and ship their corresponding source; the CUDA engine ships as verified parts beside its installer. None is Authenticode-signed. DirectML and CUDA are published labelled untested: DirectML is still outside the GPU tolerance and CUDA has not run on an NVIDIA GPU.
gates.next_action: Repeat the manual desktop checks on a Windows PC, obtain a code-signing certificate, run the CUDA installer on an NVIDIA GPU and bring DirectML within tolerance.

gates.summary: The Linux CPU, AMD ROCm and NVIDIA CUDA AppImages of v0.1.3-beta are built on GitHub-hosted runners, pass verify_codec_allowlist, the NVIDIA redistribution policy, an installed-package smoke test and the architecture check, and ship corresponding source including Ubuntu sources for every bundled host library. The ROCm AppImage carries Ubuntu's own libnuma and libelf in place of the AlmaLinux copies in PyTorch's wheel. CUDA is published labelled untested; ROCm ran on a Radeon RX 9060 XT in earlier builds.
gates.next_action: Repeat the manual desktop checks on a Linux desktop, including the ROCm AppImage on the RX 9060 XT, and run the CUDA AppImage on an NVIDIA GPU.

gates.summary: macOS, the Windows CPU, DirectML and CUDA installers and the Linux CPU, ROCm and CUDA AppImages of v0.1.3-beta are published through the website and GitHub Releases. The Microsoft Store listing (HerRei.LocalSR) is not published.
gates.next_action: Submit the Store package once the Windows build is code-signed.

gates.summary: Maintainer assessment without legal counsel (17 September 2026) in docs/licensing-media.md: demuxing, a user-installed FFmpeg, MPEG-2/AC-3 expiry and OS codecs are settled or negligible; NVIDIA's terms stay open, so CUDA packages are withheld.
gates.next_action: Revisit before publishing any CUDA package.

gates.summary: NVIDIA CUDA (published, labelled untested), Linux Intel XPU (withheld) and DirectML adapters other than the UHD 620 have not run on physical hardware.
gates.next_action: Collect volunteer hardware reports before describing these engines as tested.

gates.summary: HDR preservation, SeedVR2 3B, de-flicker and video face processing ship as Labs features. Perceptual HDR quality and long-clip temporal stability are unverified.
gates.next_action: Recommend short clips and state the memory and time limits in the app.
